NETFILE service page, captured 2026-08. B10: registered and cited, NOTHING authored. Two citations record what the page actually states: the transmission window — open Monday, February 23, 2026 at 6:00 a.m. Eastern until Friday, January 29, 2027, unavailable 3 to 6 a.m. ET daily and February 1 to 22, 2026 — and the eligibility restrictions. A channel service window is an operational fact about CRA's transmitter, not a tax rule and not a taxpayer deadline; the certified model has no filing-channel semantic, and rules.rule_deadline is a child of a rule version, so recording it would mean inventing a rule from a filing page

files.internal_title: T4002 Self-employed Business, Professional, Commission, Farming and Fishing Income
files.note: T4002(E) Rev. 25, the 2025 guide. B12: six CCA class rates authored from its class-description headings (14.1, 43, 43.1, 43.2, 44, 53), and its own CCA-rates chart (p.106) cited as the second, independent statement of the 19 rates the web chapter's table carries — the two agree on every class. NO rule or formula authored: the CCA computation is a stateful per-class pool (Area A Column 2 starts from prior-year UCC; Column 18 applies the half-year rule to net current-year additions), the formula language is six stateless operations, and no fact exists for UCC, additions, dispositions or class membership — REPRESENTATION_BLOCKER, reported not simulated. The June 15/April 30 filing obligations it states have no outcome type in the certified vocabulary and rule_deadline is a child of a rule version — also blocked, not distorted into a recommendation. Located by publication number; the PDF prints no document URL

files.internal_title: Interest rates for the third calendar quarter
files.note: prescribed interest, 2026-Q3. B04: five rates from the 'Income tax' section authored for 2026-07-01..2026-09-30, the window the document states for itself. The REPRESENTATION_BLOCKER this batch raised is CLOSED: rules.calc_constant now carries an effective period and an exclusion constraint refusing overlapping ones, so a quarter is stored as a quarter rather than encoded into a code or filed as the annual value. The 'Other taxes, duties, or charges' table — GST/HST, excise, fuel-charge, softwood lumber, UHT, luxury, digital services, global minimum tax — is extracted and recorded, not authored: none of it is a personal income-tax semantic. No runtime consumer reads prescribed interest, so nothing was wired

files.internal_title: When to register for and start charging the GST/HST
files.note: When to register for and start charging the GST/HST, modified 2026-06-16. B13: GST_SMALL_SUPPLIER_THRESHOLD 30000 CAD authored for 2026 from the most-businesses table; RC4022 states the identical figure. The three temporal tests the table defines — a single-calendar-quarter test, a four-consecutive-calendar-quarter test, and cessation at the end of the month following the crossing quarter — are NOT authored: they measure worldwide taxable-supply revenue BEFORE expenses, including associates, per calendar quarter, and no fact measures taxable supplies at all, let alone by quarter; collapsing them into an annual net-income predicate would author a different rule than the source states. The event-relative timing (effective date no later than the crossing supply; register within 29 days) and the taxi/ride-share must-register-regardless carve-out are likewise blocked: deadlines carry only fixed dates as children of a rule version, and no occupation fact exists. The 50,000 and 250,000 public-service-body/charity figures are extracted and recorded, not authored — out of product scope
